integrity: Original graph and budget are explicitly defined. Determinants, exact derivative identities, roots and KKT boundary signs can be reproduced with the included standalone checker.
scientific_limitations: Unit-weight complete bipartite edges and only two vertex-price classes; interior allocation defined by unique scalar root. Finite checks do not prove all parameter cases; a complete analytic proof is supplied. Unindexed equivalent results cannot be ruled out.
title: Sharp price and budget thresholds for D-optimal grounding on complete bipartite networks
